content: @distube/ytdl-core v4.16.12 (last published June 2025). ESM: import ytdl from '@distube/ytdl-core'. Stream to file: ytdl(url, { filter: 'videoandaudio', quality: 'highest' }).pipe(fs.createWriteStream('video.mp4')). Can filter by container: filter: f => f.container === 'mp4'. WARNING: Repository archived August 16, 2025 - no longer maintained. Maintainers recommend youtubei.js as replacement. HTTP 429 (rate limiting) is a known issue. Context D-02 locks in this package but archival is a significant risk signal.
